newsitem.title: USA: Continental cuts holiday fares up to 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Continental cuts holiday fares up to 40 pct.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said on Tuesday that it is offering up to 40 percent savings from standard leisure fares during the Christmas and New Year holidays.
Fare cuts are good for travel between December 19, 1996 and January 7, 1997 throughout the United States and Canada, the company said.
Tickets must be purchased on or before December 20, 1996 and reservations must be made seven days in advance, the Continental said.
Certain travel dates are "blacked out" and other restrictions may apply, the carrier said.
Continental is matching rival carriers' fare cuts that were sparked by Northwest Airlines Corp's discounts announced yesterday.
